title: Retail Installment Contracts and Repossession and Collateral Recovery: Referral-History Review Days on Payoffs
content:
A borrower payoff of a contract under Retail Installment Contracts carries referral-history review days read from the contract's repossession cases under Repossession and Collateral Recovery: how each case closed, its closing date and, for a recalled case, its recall reason.

**Rule.**

1. When the contract's repossession case closed as **reinstated** (a contract is reinstated at most once) and closed later than the same calendar day **24** months before the posting date (the last day of that month when that day does not exist), **3** review days are added.
2. When that is not so, but a repossession case on the contract closed as **recalled** with the recall reason *account brought current*, **1** review day is added.
3. Otherwise none are added.

| Repossession case history | Review days |
|---|---|
| reinstated, closed within the 24 months | 3 |
| reinstated, closed on or before the 24-month mark, and a case recalled as account brought current | 1 |
| a case recalled as account brought current, no reinstated case | 1 |
| reinstated, closed on or before the 24-month mark, nothing else | none |
| recalled for another reason, redeemed, sold, or no case | none |

**Boundary (hypothetical posting date 31 May).** A reinstated case closed 1 June two years earlier is inside the window (3 days); one closed 31 May two years earlier is not later than the mark.
